title: Dashboard QA scratchpad - handoffs & follow-ups
content:
Personal scratchpad - Dashboard QA (hand-off list + quick repro notes)

Context:
- Picking through incoming dashboard reports from last 48h window. Most from customer sessions (AcmePay & MyLoan) showing >2s widget render spikes and missing token-level cost breakdowns on several routes.
- Quick goal: capture repro steps, who to ping, and minimal mitigation (workaround or rollback) if needed.

Open items (priority order):
1) Route latency spike (route: /v1/generate) - AcmePay (CS-3421)
   - Symptom: spike to 2.3s median for 1h starting ~2026-03-09T02:10Z.
   - Quick checks done: no infra autoscaler events in SRE dashboard; serving runtime showed elevated batching at 02:10Z (batch size jumped from 4->16).
   - Repro notes: Hit /v1/generate with seq_len=512 and parallel 8 clients using postman script. Local sim reproduces ~1.9s, but only when KV cache disabled.
   - Next steps: ask infra to surface batching config for that time (Samir). File ticket OBS-1289 for root-cause tracking.

2) Missing token breakdown in per-route cost graphs - internal console bug
   - Symptom: token-level breakdown column empty for routes using model variant v2-q4.
   - Likely cause: serializer change in console that doesn't handle quantized model metrics. Suspect PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/432.
   - Fast mitigation: show total tokens if breakdown missing (UX change) — short term patch.
   - Owner: Jordan to prototype patch + unit test.

3) Widget render flicker (customer MyLoan)
   - Customer-facing: UI flicker when streaming begins (blank 300ms then data)
   - Hypothesis: frontend waiting for first chunk that has content marker; backend stream changed chunking (see OBS-1310 notes).
   - Workaround: toggle streaming-mode safe-guard (frontend flag) to display spinner immediately.
   - Owner: Jordan (frontend), follow-up with UX to not escalate.

Meeting notes / calls to make:
- 03/11 09:30 PT: quick sync with Samir to check batching telemetry retention (on my calendar). Agenda: confirm if batching policy changed, map events to customer spikes.
- 03/11 11:00 PT: demo patch for token breakdown fallback (Jordan) — ask for review from product-hosted-api.

Quick scratch actions (todo):
- [ ] Attach small repro script for /v1/generate to OBS-1289 (local reproducer + env vars) -> me (Ella)
- [ ] Ping SRE slack (#sre-observability) with snippet of batch-size anomaly at 02:10Z -> Samir
- [ ] Create temporary dashboard panel showing "batch-size over time" and alert if >12 for >5m -> me
- [ ] Draft short message for AcmePay CS: explain we're investigating and share workaround (prefer not to mention internal rollback unless needed) -> Samir + CS
- [ ] Prototype fallback UI for token breakdown when missing -> Jordan

Notes to self / heuristics:
- When reproducing latency, toggle KV cache on/off; many regressions only surface w/ cache cold.
- Re-run evening job that simulates rolling traffic (seq_len distribution) before next morning to catch regressions early.
- Keep a concise changelog snippet for any console patches to avoid repeated customer confusion.

Unresolved questions:
- Did model compilation kernel change for v2-q4 last week? (check infra-release notes)
- Is there correlation between increased GPU packing and batch-size spikes? Need time-series join between packing metrics and batch-size.

Hand-off checklist (if I step away):
- Everything above is captured in OBS-1289 (latency) and CS-3421 (customer ticket).
- Slack thread: #obs-acmepay-incident — if no reply within 30m, escalate to oncall@redwood.sre.
- If customer experiences more than 5% error increase, open a P0 incident and call out dedicated capacity owner.

Timestamps / quick log (for personal tracking):
- 2026-03-09 02:15Z: noticed batch spike while skimming metrics
- 2026-03-09 02:40Z: reproduced locally with cache off
- 2026-03-11 08:12PT: drafted this scratchpad before sync

Snippets to copy into tickets (trim before pasting):
- "Observed batch-size jump to 16 for route /v1/generate starting 2026-03-09T02:10Z. Local repro when KV cache disabled; median latency increased ~0.9s. Need batching config and runtime trace for that interval."

Random/notes-to-self:
- If we add a temporary alert for batch-size, threshold: >12 for 5m -> severity: page (to oncall)
- Keep customer-facing language high-level: "intermittent rendering delays due to backend batching behavior; workaround available"

End of scratchpad. Will prune after sync and move action items into OBS tickets.
